Install

Track Kommander runs inside Traktor Pro 4.5.1 (build 21). Other Traktor versions are refused: Track Kommander has to know Traktor's exact build, so each Traktor update needs a Track Kommander release made for it.

You need an Apple Silicon Mac (M1 or later), macOS 13 or newer, Traktor Pro 4.5.1 in its usual place, and about 700 MB of disk.

  1. Download Track Kommander.dmg from Releases and open it.

  2. Copy the install line into Terminal. Open Install - copy this line into Terminal.txt in the disk image, copy its line, paste it into Terminal (Applications → Utilities → Terminal) and press Return:

    bash "/Volumes/Track Kommander/Install Track Kommander.command"

    The installer runs in that Terminal window. Double-clicking Install Track Kommander.command instead works only after System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway, and not on every Mac: macOS refuses unsigned installers downloaded from the internet.

  3. Type your Mac password when Terminal asks (nothing shows while you type: Traktor's folder is protected). If Traktor is running, the installer waits for you to quit it. Questions come up in Terminal too — answer y or n.

  4. When it is done, Finder shows Traktor Pro 4 TK next to Traktor Pro 4, and it opens. Next time, open Traktor Pro 4 TK yourself (keep it in the Dock if you like).

What the installer does. It makes Traktor Pro 4 TK on your Mac, from your own Traktor: Traktor's program, told to load Track Kommander, with Track Kommander and its own Python inside; Traktor's other files are used through links, not copied. It is signed "ad hoc" for your Mac, because a changed Traktor cannot keep Native Instruments' signature. Your Traktor Pro 4 is not touched, and the disk image holds no Native Instruments file. A log is kept in ~/Library/Logs/Track Kommander/install.log.

Remove it: drag Traktor Pro 4 TK to the Bin. To remove everything, delete ~/Library/Application Support/Track Kommander and ~/Library/Caches/Track Kommander too.

You need Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), Traktor Pro 4.5.1 installed in its usual place, and about 700 MB of disk.

  1. Download TrackKommanderSetup.msi from Releases and run it. Windows may warn that the publisher is unknown (the installer is not signed): More info → Run anyway.
  2. Start Traktor with Track Kommander from its Start-menu shortcut (quit Traktor first). It checks that your Traktor is the supported version, then starts it with Track Kommander inside.

Your Traktor is never changed: the launcher starts your installed Traktor and loads Track Kommander into it. Starting Traktor from its own shortcut gives you Traktor without Track Kommander, as before.

Remove it: Settings → Apps → Track Kommander → Uninstall. To remove everything, delete %LOCALAPPDATA%\Track Kommander too.

First run

  1. Open Traktor with Track Kommander (macOS: Traktor Pro 4 TK; Windows: the Start-menu shortcut). Its band appears above Traktor's browser after a few seconds; the first start takes a little longer.
  2. Let it analyse your collection. It starts by itself while Traktor is idle and carries on in the background; a large collection takes a while the first time and nothing afterwards.
  3. Pick the deck to match with A–D in the band, and click Track Kommander in Traktor's tree: the list fills with the best matches.

macOS may ask whether "Traktor Pro 4" may use your Music folder, your microphone or your controllers: allow, as you did for your normal Traktor (it asks again because the TK copy is a different app to macOS).

Troubleshooting

  • The band says "Track Kommander not found at …" — the app was not made completely: install it again from the disk image (macOS) or repair it from Settings → Apps (Windows).
  • The band says "No answer from Track Kommander" — it is still starting (give it a few seconds), or it stopped: quit Traktor and open it again. If it keeps happening, send the logs below.
  • After a Traktor update, Track Kommander does not start — each Traktor build needs a Track Kommander release made for it. Until that release is out, use Traktor as usual.
  • Logs — please attach them to a bug report:
    • macOS: ~/Library/Logs/Track Kommander/ (the installer and the start inside Traktor), /tmp/tk_dylib.log (Track Kommander's loader) and ~/Library/Application Support/Track Kommander/logs/
    • Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Track Kommander\logs\
